name: omnigraph
title: Omnigraph
description: A typed graph database for AI agents, with git-style branches and merges, graph, vector and full-text search in one query, and Cedar access policies. Agents connect over MCP; people use the omnigraph CLI, the TypeScript SDK or the Omnigraph Studio desktop app. Starts empty: you add graphs with `omnigraph cluster apply`.

defaultEnv.label: Admin Token
defaultEnv.description: Bearer token for the server's `hola-admin` actor, used by the omnigraph CLI, SDKs and MCP clients (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). It can change the cluster's configuration and, under the graph policies you apply, read and write graphs. Generated for you; find it later under this app's configuration.
